_meta.note: Replaces prioritization.py's old hand-set WEIGHTS = {hazard: 0.50, population: 0.20, socioeconomic: 0.15, history: 0.15} (see decisions-and-learnings.md / chat-log item 6). These comparisons were chosen to approximately reproduce that same 0.50/0.20/0.15/0.15 split through genuine pairwise judgments rather than re-typing the decimals directly — the resolved weights (~0.49/0.23/0.14/0.14) are close but not identical, which is expected: AHP's whole point is that the ratios come from independent pairwise comparisons, not from reverse-engineering an exact target vector. Same 'seeded by Claude from already-documented reasoning, not a real elicitation' caveat as the other four judgment files — see judgments/README.md before treating this file's CR pass as anything beyond internal arithmetic consistency.
